description: This file contains mock data functions for a financial insights tracker frontend, including functions to generate mock categories, transactions, alerts, alert severities, and insights, as well as a helper function to generate ISO date strings.

methods.name: isoDate
methods.description: Generates an ISO date string for a date 'daysAgo' days before today.

methods.name: getMockCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of mock transaction categories for filters.

methods.name: getMockAlertSeverities
methods.description: Returns a list of mock alert severity levels.

methods.name: getMockTransactions
methods.description: Returns a list of mock transaction objects for UI development.

methods.name: getMockAlerts
methods.description: Returns a list of mock alert objects for UI development.

methods.name: getMockInsights
methods.description: Returns a list of mock insight objects for placeholder rendering.
